aureliahr.summary: A team management web app built as my engineering thesis.
aureliahr.problem: Information about a team, its tasks and responsibilities is often scattered across spreadsheets, emails and chat apps — it's hard to get one up-to-date picture of the team's work.
aureliahr.solution: I designed and built a React web app backed by MongoDB that brings team data and work together in one place.
aureliahr.result: A working application delivered as my engineering thesis — the full stack from interface to database. The code is available on GitHub.

gpsmaker.summary: A Python and pandas script that processes CSV files with GPS data.
gpsmaker.problem: Cleaning up large CSV files with GPS points by hand is tedious and error-prone.
gpsmaker.solution: I wrote a Python script that uses pandas to load, clean and transform GPS data into the required format.
gpsmaker.result: Repeatable data processing with a single script run instead of manual spreadsheet work.

webscraping.summary: My first script that ended up being used by others.
webscraping.problem: The data we needed was only available on web pages — copying it by hand took a lot of time.
webscraping.solution: I wrote a Python script that automatically fetches and saves the data from those pages.
webscraping.result: Other people started using the tool — my first code with real users.

noescapecursor.summary: A program that locks the cursor to the primary monitor while a selected game or app is active.
noescapecursor.problem: On multi-monitor setups the cursor in fullscreen games can slip onto another screen and minimise the window at the worst possible moment.
noescapecursor.solution: I built a lightweight program that detects the selected game or app and locks the edges of the primary monitor while it runs.
noescapecursor.result: The cursor stays where it should, and the program runs in the background with no extra setup.

portfolio.summary: This website — a bilingual showcase combining a client offer with a profile for recruiters.
portfolio.problem: The previous version mixed roles and styles, had no offer or path for recruiters, and the code was full of duplication.
portfolio.solution: I rebuilt the site with React, TypeScript and Tailwind: a UI component system, data in typed modules, PL/EN translations, service pages and a portfolio with case studies.
portfolio.result: A consistent, accessible and fast site on GitHub Pages that's easy to extend — a new project is a single data entry.
